text:
sophie: deploybot blocked EU canary for RC-12 — registry SBOM digest missing (cosign attached but no sbom). blocking rollout. what do we want to do? wait for sign, pin previous image for EU, or full rollback? :thinking:

dev-deploy-bot: Automated check report:
```
canary: rc-12
region: eu-west-1
status: BLOCKED
reason: SBOM_MISSING
artifact: gcr.io/redwood/rc-12:sha256:abcd1234
checks: cosign=present sbom=absent
queued_since: 120s
```

arjun: if it's just an sbom propagation lag i'd wait 10-15m and re-run the sbom fetch. we've seen registry indexers lag during heavy pushes.

marta: watch SLA here — EU customers on dedicated must not see degraded behavior. if wait > 30m we should carve out EU and continue NA/APAC. partial rollout preferred over rollback imo. :warning:

samir: +1 partial rollout. fallback plan: pin EU to previous image (rc-11) for the canary cohort, proceed with NA/APAC. low blast radius. also open support with registry for sbom propagation trace.

leo-release: decision tree proposal (short):
1) wait 20m, recheck SBOM. if appears -> continue full rollout.
2) if still missing at 20m -> carveout EU: pin rc-11 to eu canary and promote rc-12 in NA/APAC only.
3) if rc-11 pin fails or rollback risk > threshold -> rollback global to rc-11 and escalate.
Set a hard cutoff at 45m for global rollback.

legal-bot: note: if SBOM is missing but cosign present, legal can approve a timeboxed exception only if provenance evidence (build logs + cosign attest) is attached in the ticket. we can fast-track signature review but need @sophie or @samir to attach.

sophie: copying decision tree. i'll do the carveout if sbom still missing at +20m. @dev-deploy-bot run:apply-carveout --region eu-west-1 --image gcr.io/redwood/rc-11:sha256:prev --cohort canary

dev-deploy-bot: Command received. executing in 30s. run_id=run_20260320_71

arjun: i'll tail the registry logs and ping if sbom arrives early.

marta: i'll update release notes and the incident tag (internal) w/ the carveout reason and decision tree.

sophie: attaching build provenance to the ticket now (link: https://internal/tickets/INC-7921). tagging @legal-bot for exception review.

samir: thanks. after carveout we should schedule a postmortem on why SBOM propagation lagged during CI deploy. not normal.

dev-deploy-bot: Carveout applied: eu-west-1 canary pinned to rc-11. NA/APAC continuing rc-12 rollout. run_id=run_20260320_71 status=OK

leo-release: clear. i'll mark release notes: "EU canary pinned due to SBOM propagation lag; global rollout to resume after sbom confirmation or 45m global cutoff."

sophie: closing loop — will revert carveout automatically if sbom shows up and cosign attests pass. otherwise follow rollback at 45m. :white_check_mark:
